items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Jorge Dalto, the Argentine Piano player with Benson

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Who are you thinking of? Can you name some names?

I don't remember any -- somebody brought me a bass player recorded me on a Victor album called Machito Goes Memphis. Oh, man, that guy could really play. And there's another guy with (inaudible) Jorge Dalto, the Argentine Piano player with Benson (inaudible)?
